limitations: Empirical p99 uses32/128 observations (slow shape8); no stable tail inference.
HeapAlloc sampling can miss transients; synchronized live postGC and actual storage capacities supply separate evidence.
Inclusive runtime-delta heap contains driver, TLS, harness/GC bookkeeping; it is not a driver-only exact heap attribution.
Kernel TCP_INFO bytes are actual socket bytes; process I/O syscall snapshots include endpoint/background/file I/O and are not net.Conn call or TLS record counters.
Original scalar unchecked baseline timings lack v2 safety contracts; no speedup claim derives from those cases.
Frame-compressed v3/v4 RunStream rejects per contract; buffered Row/NextInto compare in those modes.
Step16 independent review and step17 final complete native/release matrix remain.
